description: Starter diagnosis catalog of nic-report.py (docs/design/nic-sweep.md §6.3.1). Generic and public: site rules go in a separate file layered on with --rules.

rules.diagnosis: Attenuated optical path: Rx {rx_dbm} dBm is {rx_below_db} dB below the median of {rx_delta_basis}, and the link is failing now ({link_down_recent|no count of} link-down messages in the look-back window, {carrier_changes|unknown} carrier changes since driver load, {phy_err_window|an unknown number of} symbol errors in the window).
rules.action: Clean or inspect both fibre ends, then replace the optic and the cable leg to {peer|the switch port (no LLDP neighbour at collection)}; check the switch side's Tx and DOM for that lane.

rules.diagnosis: Latent attenuation: Rx {rx_dbm} dBm is {rx_below_db} dB below the median of {rx_delta_basis}, with {phy_err_total} symbol errors since boot and {phy_err_window|an unknown number of} new ones in the window: the same fault between bursts.
rules.action: Same remediation as an active attenuated path, before the next burst: clean or inspect both fibre ends, then replace the optic and the cable leg to {peer|the switch port (no LLDP neighbour at collection)}.

rules.diagnosis: Marginal transceiver or breakout lane: errors keep growing ({phy_err_window} symbol errors in the window, {phy_err_total} since boot) while Rx {rx_dbm} dBm is normal for its type, so not attenuation.
rules.action: Replace the optic or that breakout lane; check the peer port {peer|(no LLDP neighbour at collection)} and its sibling lanes.

rules.diagnosis: Past flapping: {carrier_changes} carrier changes since driver load, {flaps_window|an unknown number} in the window.
rules.action: Watch with a longer window (nic-health -I 60 or more) and inspect the cable to {peer|the switch port}.

rules.diagnosis: PCIe link trained at {pcie_trained} where card and slot support {pcie_supported}, on {role_hosts_pcie} of {role_hosts} hosts of the role: a shared cause.
rules.action: Check the BIOS PCIe slot speed and bifurcation profile of {slot_label|that slot} before replacing hardware; then reseat the card or riser.

rules.diagnosis: PCIe link trained at {pcie_trained} where card and slot support {pcie_supported}, on this host only.
rules.action: Reseat the card (and its riser) in {slot_label|its slot}; check the slot's BIOS link speed.

rules.diagnosis: PCIe link trained at {pcie_trained} where card and slot support {pcie_supported}, on {role_hosts_pcie} of {role_hosts} hosts of the role (fewer than half): more likely seating or a riser on each than a shared cause.
rules.action: Reseat the card (and its riser) in {slot_label|its slot}; check the slot's BIOS link speed.

rules.diagnosis: The bus is a bottleneck: receive buffer discards keep growing on {rx_discards_ports}.
rules.action: Fixing the PCIe link speed should stop the discards; re-check them afterwards.

rules.diagnosis: Configuration: the module needs FEC but the link runs {fec|without the FEC it requires}.
rules.action: Enable RS-FEC on the NIC port and on the switch port {peer|(no LLDP neighbour at collection)}.

rules.diagnosis: The NIC's link troubleshooting reports bad signal integrity (opcode {deep_opcode}: {deep_recommendation|no recommendation}).
rules.action: Inspect or replace the cable or that lane to {peer|the switch port}.

rules.diagnosis: The same issue ({issues}) on role {role} at {sites_with} sites ({sites}): a systemic weakness such as a cabling standard, breakout harness or part batch.
rules.action: Audit that position on role {role} at every site.

rules.diagnosis: Mis-cabled or misconfigured LAG: the members of {bond} are on different LACP aggregators or partners, so part of the bond is not aggregated.
rules.action: Check the switch LAG/MC-LAG membership of {peers|the members' switch ports}.

rules.diagnosis: A member of {bond} negotiated a different speed ({bond_speeds} Mb/s): wrong optic, autonegotiation or breakout mode.
rules.action: Check the optic type and the switch port speed of {peers|the members' switch ports}.

rules.diagnosis: Members of {bond} have different MTUs ({bond_mtus}): large frames are dropped on one path.
rules.action: Align the MTU on the members of {bond}.

rules.diagnosis: No switch redundancy: every member of {bond} reaches {bond_peer_switches}, so losing that switch takes the bond down.
rules.action: Re-patch one member of {bond} to the second switch.

rules.diagnosis: The switch port advertises VLANs {vlans|none} where most {role} hosts get {role_vlans} on this port (only as reliable as the switch's LLDP VLAN TLVs).
rules.action: Compare the configuration of {peer|the switch port} with its role peers' ports.

rules.diagnosis: Weak optical signal on a NIC without vendor deep data: Rx {rx_dbm} dBm is {rx_below_db} dB below the median of {rx_delta_basis} (nic-xray, ethtool -m).
rules.action: Clean or inspect both fibre ends, then replace the optic and the cable leg to {peer|the switch port (no LLDP neighbour at collection)}.
